Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Scandinavian Wall Sconce, 8"H, Matte Black
Colors: Black
This hooded wall sconce can offer directed spotlighting of a bookcase or favorite painting, or it can simply help to brighten a dark corner or hallway. Matte-black with a little pop of pale woodgrain, the sconce is both subtle and stylish. This wall sconce is made out of metal and wood. This wall sconce will allow you to add light and style to dim corners and hallways. This sconce has a modern design with classic touches that make it neatly blend with any room. 5"W x 5"D x 8"H Simple assembly in 15-30 minutes This lamp comes with a bulb and is rated for indoor use.
